description: Runs once after the first commit. Start requests, subscriptions and timers here.
Runs after every re-render commit (not after mount). Compare with `prevProps`/`prevState` before acting to avoid loops.
Runs before the instance is removed. Undo everything started in `componentDidMount`.
`render` must be pure and may run more than once. Lifecycle methods named `componentDid*` run after the DOM is updated and may cause side effects.
Values stored on `this` (timer ids, controllers) survive renders without triggering them, like `useRef` in function components.
